sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3 4B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B is a 4 billion parameter dense language model from the Qwen3 series, designed to support both general-purpose and reasoning-intensive tasks. It introduces a dual-mode architecture—thinking and non-thinking—allowing dynamic switching between high-precision logical reasoning and efficient dialogue generation.
